## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

WatchRaceComplicationDataSourceService — new symbol, app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/race (no such service exists yet; `WatchComplicationEntry` at app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/race/WatchComplicationEntry.kt computes the target but is never called)

## Trigger

A tap on the watch-face complication — nothing observes it: no `ComplicationDataSourceService` is declared anywhere in `app-wear`, and `AndroidManifest.xml` (app-wear/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml) registers only `MainActivity` and the two Data Layer listener services, no complication source

## Today

`WatchComplicationEntry.entryPoint(current: WatchDestination)` exists and is unit-tested (app-wear/src/test/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/race/WatchComplicationEntryTest.kt) but has no caller anywhere in `app-wear/src/main`. No class extends a complication data source service, so no complication is ever published, and no manifest entry advertises one to the watch face picker. `MainActivity` (app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/MainActivity.kt) only ever renders the screen named by `WatchRaceNavigator.current`, set by the navigator's own sequential transitions (`toPreparation`, `launchRace`, `swipeForward`, `onMarked`, etc.); it has no `onNewIntent` handling and reads no extra that would let an external tap select a destination. `WatchRaceNavigator` (app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/race/WatchRaceNavigator.kt) exposes no method to jump its `current` `StateFlow` directly to an arbitrary `WatchDestination` — every transition method checks the current state and moves to one fixed next state.

## Expected

The watch declares a `ComplicationDataSourceService` that publishes a complication while a race is in progress (mirroring `RaceRecordingRepository.findInProgress()`, already used by `MainActivity`), and the manifest registers it so the watch face can pick it up. A tap on the published complication opens the app on the page `WatchComplicationEntry.entryPoint(current)` names, passing the current `WatchDestination` through the tap's `PendingIntent`. This requires a second, related gap: `WatchRaceNavigator` has no way to set `current` directly from an external trigger — every existing method only advances from one specific state to the next in the swipe/mark sequence — so a method is needed that lets `MainActivity` (via a new `onNewIntent` handling reading the complication tap's target extra) move the navigator straight to the destination `entryPoint` names, bypassing the forward-only chain.
